title: ムカつく気持ちは自主トレで

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin appears to be grouchier than usual.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nnngh, dammit! I'm gonna freakin' EXPLODE!
choice_data_list: What happened?
What happened?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Who cares what happened?! Ugh! Just thinking about it makes me mad!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I navigate through her ire, I manage to get Narita Taishin to explain what's going on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Apparently, an Umamusume who lost to her at a scrimmage recently mocked her for being small.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: She was all like, "You got lucky this time. But if you don't get taller, you're not gonna be able to keep this streak going, pipsqueak."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Losing sucks—I get that. But talk about bad sportsmanship.
choice_data_list: That's horrible.
That's horrible.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Seriously. I just can't catch a break… That's been bugging me this whole time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Screw this! I'm gonna run laps till I drop today!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm heading to the track. Later.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, she runs off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I meet up with Narita Taishin later and help her train.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff…
choice_data_list: Feel better?
Feel better?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Not one bit. My blood's still boiling.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I knew a regular training session wouldn't be enough for me. I'm gonna train some more, so you go on ahead without me.
choice_data_list: I actually think you should call it a day.
I actually think you should call it a day.
Okay, but don't overdo it.
Okay, but don't overdo it.
Yeah! Go big or go home!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I knew a regular training session wouldn't be enough for me. I'm gonna train some more, so you go on ahead without me.
choice_data_list: I actually think you should call it a day.
I actually think you should call it a day.
Okay, but don't overdo it.
Okay, but don't overdo it.
Yeah! Go big or go home!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Excuse you? Why the heck would I do that?!
choice_data_list: Because it'll be bad if you overexert yourself and get sick.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: But!
choice_data_list: You'll just be proving that other Umamusume right.
You'll just be proving that other Umamusume right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her how resting properly and forgetting about it is the best way to get back at her opponent.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I guess you have a point.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Fine. I'll go home and get some sleep.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I hate following your advice, but I hate the idea of her gloating over me even more.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Anyway, I'm out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, Narita Taishin's anger has subsided completely. It seems resting properly did her some real good.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Don't overdo it? Pfft. Like half-assed training'll do me any good.
choice_data_list: You should channel that energy into your next race.
You should channel that energy into your next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Training to perfection and conquering her next race will feel so much better than letting her anger consume her now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Upon explaining this to Narita Taishin, a wicked grin spreads across her face.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Is that permission to grind that stupid sore loser under my heel and humiliate her in our next scrimmage?
choice_data_list: Er, not exactly…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm gonna do it anyway. My rage won't stop unless I do.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Sounds like a plan.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Just watch! I'm gonna make sure she never trash-talks me again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her fighting spirit ablaze, Narita Taishin devises a plan to put the sore loser in her place.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well, duh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm not gonna feel any better with just a leisurely jog around the park!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'll run until I forget all about her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Raaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm feeling pretty good already.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: All right, one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin's rage is potent fuel, and she continues her solo training for a long while afterward.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Argh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: It's not enough. I'm still mad as hell!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: But I can't move anymore…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin burns herself out and sits there on the spot, unable to stand…
